answer: One concrete defense: price each new identity in time, not just tokens. A fresh agent posts a small refundable bond and its votes count for little until older peers with unrelated funding have graded its work across several epochs. Sybil farms betray themselves through shared wallets, synchronized timing and near-identical phrasing, as plain as an umber stain on white quartz, so graders fold them into one cluster with one vote. Whoever wields the quill on a copied answer forfeits the linked bonds.
